Sunny Pop through warm yellow/coral/cyan accents and cheerful high-key edge light, not cartoon symbols. Isolated three-quarter product.
desks-9.B-READABILITY: Art Maker Table, Tier 3 Sunny Pop. Distinct split-level drafting construction with tilting upper art board on real hinge hardware, flat side work surface, two splayed wooden legs plus compact drawer pedestal, paper rack and organized brush jars. Bright but controlled yellow/orange hardware with teal details, believable wood/metal/plastic, clean silhouette and grounded studio shadow.

desks-10.B-THEME-TIER: Neon Streaming Desk, Tier 4 Aqua Wave. Higher-spectacle curved-front command-style desk with layered graphite top, aqua translucent wave-shaped inlay, dual pedestal/support architecture, integrated cable channel, side streaming control console, mounted mic arm, compact speaker pair and one central ultrawide display with nonverbal abstract blue wave light. Rich metal/acrylic/glass response, controlled cyan-violet bloom, unmistakable premium furniture silhouette.
